event.statement: A dense material loses its cohesion and enters the air as vibration.

event.process: A dense mass yields its structure to the air, becoming pressure that crosses without leaving a mark.
Cohesion releases. The grain separates from the mass without violence.
The particulate becomes suspended. Weight no longer governs movement.
Pressure shaped by constraint becomes signal. The formless acquires direction.

event.title: How does the field cross between nodes?
event.context: The chain has three nodes. The relation between them determines the structural logic of the whole.

options.label: dissolution
options.detail: Each node continues the previous dissolution.

options.label: inversion
options.detail: Each node reverses the previous state.

options.label: accumulation
options.detail: Each node adds a layer to a building structure.

dramatization.human_match: A person who holds something solid and watches it become inaudible
dramatization.central_conflict: Between weight that anchors and signal that escapes

agents.name: The Weight
agents.intention: To remain legible, to not scatter

agents.name: The Signal
agents.intention: To reach further than the body allows

event.rationale: Three nodes map to three movements of a single dissolution event.

event.prose: The grain held. That was the first thing — not the release but the holding, the way each particle pressed against the next with a pressure too small to name but sufficient to constitute a surface. The surface had a temperature. The surface could be touched.

They are no longer subject to the same law. The particles that were stone are moving through air that was not waiting for them, and the air accepts them without acknowledgment, and they continue moving, and nothing has changed except the law that was holding them has stopped applying.

You hear it because it has direction. Direction is not a property of the particle; it is something the constraint gives it. The whisper is what constraint sounds like when it has stopped being visible. You hear the shape of what was held.
